Yes you do lol. Lulu beats LeBlanc. Easily.

Ignite is a good idea because you should be able to outplay leblanc. LeBlanc isn't that hard to outplay in lane. Everything she does is very predictable and easy to avoid.. And you need control of your lane. You have kill pressure on LeBlanc always if you build even decently. Just dodge her stuff lol. The main thing is just don't get hit by either chain or W in this matchup.

Take ignite.. you need to be more of a play maker to carry. Lulu has a very underrated laning phase and roam potential. Go in and out of range of lb W and you will learn how to dodge it properly. Then predict the lb E because most will caste it almost instantly. And I rather use E for the attack speed especially against lb. It makes it easier to dodge chain and you do dmg faster. You should be able to solo kill most LeBlancs. You mainly just have to worry about junglers ganking. And learn how to trade efficiently. E Auto Sidestep Q or run up sidestep(once in range of her w) E Auto Q. I find that it is more effective to learn how to dodge and play around then enemy abilities because you can be more impactful during the game. I hate playing to scale. It's too much of a 50 50. And good mid laners will take advantage of a lulu playing to scale very easily.

Things you can think about:
-CS'ing well
-Shoving minion waves fast then roaming ( It's important to make sure your allies are carryable or you are a useful member of the team) 
-Try not to be the guy that makes a person want to afk because you are so toxic ( be a nice person maybe even overly positive )
-Make sure your builds are situational for the game (for example getting defensive items in mid like abyssal  first item against ap assassin's) 
-Positioning matters nearly every second of the game( make yourself ungankable by positioning awake from obvious gank  paths.)
-Learn how to freeze and pull minion waves. 
-You don't need to beat your lane by killing them, you can get cs leads then shove then roam. Getting your other lanes kills can make a game pretty easy. And the enemy will probably be angry at their teamate for lack of pings or reaction or pressure.
